mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 43 degrees with clear skies near Harriet Park. You can catch the International Space Station passing over early this morning starting at 5:07 AM, rising over the northwest near Verona High School and heading toward the Fitchburg and Madison area while reaching about halfway up the sky.

City officials remind residents that alternate-side winter parking rules are in effect from November 20 through April 1 to ensure emergency vehicles and snow plows can access streets, and please note the Verona Senior Center will be closed for Thanksgiving on November 26 and 27.
We have a busy schedule ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and Main Street Trick-Or-Treat happening today, plus the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol starting tomorrow.
In recent police activity, officers handled a report on October 25 where a man was found behind the wheel at an intersection for an extended period, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so make sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop later this morning.
